title: Melting Vinyl Sorceress
description: A surreal scene features a blue-skinned female figure with white hair in braids, wearing metallic armor, emerging from a large melting black vinyl record. She has glowing yellow eyes and blue energy swirls around her. Orange liquid drips from the record onto a colorful swirling pond below where red spider-like creatures sit on green lily pads. Floating transparent orbs contain miniature scenes including a waterfall, a house, and a silhouetted figure.
